name: Automotive Lighting
description: Headlamps and signal lamps for filament lamps. Patterned lens: a paraboloid and a lens of prisms, cylinder lenses and pillows. Clear-lens headlamp: the facetted reflector of a low beam for a filament lamp (H4, H7, …) – mirror strips whose filament images touch the cut-off line, joined by walls with draft and fillets to one mouldable surface; filament images and light distribution (UN/ECE R112 test points).
